scripts.cleanall: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('packages/core/dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('packages/core/build', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:app
scripts.cleanbuild: npm run cleanall && npm run build
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:core && npm run test:app
scripts.web:dev: npm run build:core && npm --workspace @shopify-agent/web run dev
scripts.web:build: npm run build:core && npm --workspace @shopify-agent/web run build
